note: Spoken-question comprehension corpus for the VoiceChat multilingual transplant. Original text written for this repo (no dataset text). dev = tuning/screening, heldout = final only, never used for fitting or prompt/threshold choices. Answers are regexes over the agent's internal text, lower-cased and accent-stripped; any language counts (the reply language is scored separately).

text.en: What is the capital of France?
text.it: Qual è la capitale della Francia?
text.fr: Quelle est la capitale de la France ?
text.de: Was ist die Hauptstadt von Frankreich?

text.en: What is the capital of Japan?
